notes: Fix Text to Video appearing to 'not delete the old content'. The parser already overwrites src/Content.json with only the freshly-parsed scenes (old scenes ARE replaced on disk, and the rendered video is new-only), but the editor was never refreshed after a batch — so it kept showing the previous scenes, making it look like nothing changed. The 'status' socket handler now calls loadSegments() when the batch reaches 100%, so the editor reflects exactly what was rendered. Guarded with a _ttvReloaded flag (reset at the start of each batch) so the batch's two progress:100 emissions — per-script done_status + batch_complete — only reload once. Verified: mid-batch status does not reload, the two completion events reload exactly once, no console errors. (Note: past renders accumulate in renders/ by design — that's render history, not stale project content.)
